questions.qtext: Which one of the following method is used for the development of sphere?
questions.solution:
(d)

Consider the following statements regarding purpose of Grounding of electrical equipment.
1. The purpose of grounding is to safeguard people from electrical shocks, reduce the probability of a fire, and protect equipment from damage.
2. It ensures a path to the earth for the flow of excess current.
3. A ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI), also called a ground fault interrupter (GFI).
Which of the above statements is/are CORRECT?
questions.solution:
(c)
Grounding of electrical equipment is the primary method of reducing electrical hazards.
1. The purpose of grounding is to safeguard people from electrical shocks, reduce the probability
of a fire, and protect equipment from damage.
2. Grounding ensures a path to the earth for the flow of excess current.
3. Grounding also eliminates the possibility of a person being shocked by contact with a charged capacitor
Statement 3 is not describing purpose of grounding

questions.qtext:
The Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) reinforces the integrated approach by guiding the companies to have a plan with following objective:
1. Providing appropriate medical treatment for injured or ill workers.
2. Regularly examining workers who are exposed to toxic substances.
3. Having a qualified first-aid person available during all working hours.
Which of the above statements is/are CORRECT?
questions.solution:
(d)
OSHA reinforces the integrated approach by guiding companies to have a plan for doing at least the following:
1. providing appropriate medical treatment for injured or ill workers,
2. regularly examining workers who are exposed to toxic substances, and
3. having a qualified first-aid person available during all working hours.
Smaller companies may contract out the fulfillment of these requirements. Larger companies often
maintain a staff of safety and health professionals.

Consider the following statements regarding design selection and evaluation process:
1. Pugh’s method compares each concept relative to datum concept.
2. In EVAD (Design evaluation) method, the profiles are compared in a quantitative way rather than qualitative.
3. In EVAD method, design present the visual representation of the decision.
Which of the above statements are CORRECT?
questions.solution:
(a)
• Pugh chart is a relative comparison technique in which each concept is compared with reference or datum concept.
• In EVAD, the designer is presented with a visual representation of the decision to be made
and not to provide a quantitative assessment of the alternative concept.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements regarding Embodiment Design:
1. In this phase, the decisions are made on strength, material selection, size, shape and spatial compatibility.
2. Embodiment design is concerned with three major tasks – product architecture, configuration design, and parametric design.
3. It is a process in which we initiate the design and come up with a number of design concepts and then narrow down to the single best concept.
4. It is a process where the structured development of the design concepts takes place.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
(c)
Statement 3 is related to the conceptual design.
Embodiment Design is a process where the structured development of the design concepts takes
place. It is in this phase that decisions are made on strength, material selection, size, shape and
spatial compatibility. Embodiment design is concerned with three major tasks:
• Product architecture
• Configuration design
• Parametric design.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements regarding equipment dedicated only for confined space entry:
1. Prior to each entry, all equipments will be visually inspected for damage or other defects.
2. The hoist must be stable and all components capable of handling five times the weight of the person are to be lowered or raised.
3. Lighting and electrical equipment must be acceptable for the area and conditions were used.
4. Exhaust blowers removing flammable gases must discharge near sources of ignition.
Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(c)
Power ventilation providing fresh air to confined spaces must have make-up air to the blower supplied from a point where there are no other known harmful air contaminants and exhaust blowers should not discharge into employee work area. Exhaust blowers removing flammable
gases must not discharge near sources of ignition.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements regarding the goal of the OSHA Hazardous Waste Standard and other regulations :
1. Encourage companies to reduce the amount and toxicity of the hazardous substances that they use.
2. Ensure that remaining hazardous materials are used safely.
3. Ensure that companies are prepared to respond promptly and appropriately when accidents occur.
Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(d)
The goal of the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Hazardous Waste Standard
and other regulations is to (a) encourage companies to reduce the amount and toxicity of the
hazardous substances that they use, (b) ensure that remaining hazardous materials are used safely,
and (c) ensure that companies are prepared to respond promptly and appropriately when accidents
occur.
